verses.en: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.sm: O LENEI, Isaraelu e, faalogologo mai ia i tulafono ma faamasinoga ou te a‘oa‘o atu ai ia te outou tou te faia, ina ia outou ola ai, ina ia outou o atu ai foi, ma fai mo outou le nuu ua foaiina atu ia te outou e Ieova le Atua o outou tamā.

verses.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.sm: Aua tou te faaopoopo se upu i upu ou te fai atu ai ia te outou, aua foi tou te aveeseina ai se upu ; ina ia outou tausiusi i poloaiga a Ieova lo outou Atua ou te fai atu ai ia te outou.

verses.en: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.sm: Ua outou iloa i o outou mata le mea na faia e ieova ona o Paalapeoro, auā o tagata uma lava na mulimuli atu ia Paalapeoro ua faaumatia i latou nai ia te oe e Ieova lou Atua.

verses.en: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.sm: A o outou e na pipii atu ia Ieova lo outou Atua, o loo ola mai outou uma i le aso nei.

verses.en: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.sm: Faauta, na ou a£oa4o atu ia te outou i tulafono ma faamasinoga e pei ona poloai mai ai ia te au e Ieova lo£u Atua, ina ia outou faia faapea i le nuu tou te o atu ai e fai mo outou.

verses.en: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou tausiusi i a.i, ma ia outou faia, auā o le mea lea tou te popoto ai, ma atamamai ai i luina o nuu e faalogologo i nei tulafono uma ; ona faapea ane lea, E moni lava o le nuu popoto ma le atamamai lenei nuu mamalu.

verses.en: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
verses.sm: Auā o ifea se nuu mamalu ua latalata i ai lo latou atua, e pei o Ieova lo tatou Atua ua latalata mai i mea uma lava ua tatou valaau atu ai ia te ia ?

verses.en: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.sm: O ifea foi se nuu mamalu e i ai tulafono ma faamasinoga tonu, e pei o lenei tulafono uma ua ou tuuina atu ia te outou i le aso nei ?

verses.en: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;
verses.sm: Tau ina faaeteete oe ia te oe, ma ia e matuā faaeteete lava ia te oe, ne£i galo ia te oe nei mea na iloa ai e ou mata, ne‘i te‘a ese ai lou loto i aso uma o lou olaga, a ia e faailoa atu i lau fanau, ma le fanau a lau fanau ;

verses.en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.sm: faailoa atu le aso na e tu ai i luma o Ieova lou Atua i Horepa, ina o fetalai mai Ieova ia te au, Ina faapotopoto mai ia ia te au le nuu, ia latou faalogologo mai i a‘u upu, ina ia a‘oa‘oina ai i latou, ina ia matatau mai ia te au i aso uma lava latou te ola ai i le fogāeleele, ma ia latou a‘oa‘o ai i a latou fanau.

verses.en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.sm: Ona outou faalatalata atu lea ma tutū i lalo o le mauga, na mu foi le mauga i le afi, ua oo lava i le lagi; sa i ai foi le pouliuli, ma ao, ma le pogisa.

w.en: his and you all near unto

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o ieova ia te outou mai totonu o le afi, ua outou faalogologo i le siufofoga, a ua outou le iloa atu se mea e tino a‘i mai, na o le siufofoga lava.

verses.en: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.sm: Ua na faaalia foi ia te outou lana feagaiga na ia poloai mai ai ia te outou tou te faia, o upu ia e sefulu ; na ia tusi ai foi i luga o papamaa e lua.

verses.en: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.sm: Na poloai mai foi Ieova ia te au i ia ona po, e a‘oa‘o atu ia te outou i tulafono ma faamasinoga tou te faia i le nuu tou te o atu i ai e fai mo outou.

verses.en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.sm: O lenei, ia matuā faaeteete outou ia te outou, auā na outou le iloa lava se mea na tino a‘i mai i le aso na fetalai mai ai ieova ia te outou i Horepa ai totonu o le afi.

verses.en: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.sm: Ne‘i leaga outou ia te outou, ma outou faia mo outou se tupua ua ta, o le faatusa o se tupua e tasi, o le faatusa o se tane, po o se fafine;

verses.en: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.sm: o se faatusa o se tasi manu e tataa, o se faatusa o se manu lele e lele i lugā,

verses.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.sm: c se faatusa o se tasi mea e totolo i le eleele, po o se faatusa o se tasi i‘a o i le sami i lalo o le laueleele ;

verses.en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.sm: ne‘i tepa ae foi ou mata i le lagi, ma e iloa le la, ma le masina, ma fetu, o ‘au uma o le lagi, ne‘i tosina ai oe e ifo i ai, ma auauna i ai, o mea ia na tofia mai e Ieova lou Atua i nuu uma o le lalolagi.

verses.en: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
verses.sm: Auā na ave outou e Ieova, ma na aumaia outou ai le ogaumu e tunu ai uamea, nai Aikupito lava, ina ia avea ma nuu e fai mona tofi, pei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
verses.sm: Na toasa mai foi Ieova ia te au ona o a outou upu, ma na tauto ai ou te le sopoia atu Ioritana, ou te le alu atu foi i le nuu lelei, o le a foai atu ia te oe e Ieova lou Atua e fai mou tofi.

verses.en: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.sm: Auā e oti a‘u i le nuu nei, ou te le sopoia atu Ioritana ; a o outou, tou te sopoia atu, ma fai mo outou lena nuu lelei.

verses.en: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.sm: Ia outou lava, ne‘i galo ia te outou le feagaiga a Ieova lo outou Atua na ia osia ma outou, ona outou fai lea mo outou se tupua ua ta, o le faatusa lava o se mea e tasi ua vaoia mai ai e Ieova lou Atua.

verses.en: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
verses.sm: Auā o ieova lou Atua o le afi maamaai ia, o le Atua fuā ia.

verses.en: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.sm: A oo ina fai o lau fanau, ma ni fanau a lau fanau, a loa foi ona outou mau i le nuu, a leaga outou ia te outou, a outou faia foi se tupua ua ta, o se faatusa o se mea e tasi, ma faia mea leaga i luma o Ieova lou Atua, e faaonoono ai ia te ia;

verses.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.sm: ou te valaau atu i le aso nei i le lagi, ma le lalolagi, e fai ma molimau ia te outou, e vave ona matuā fano outou ai le nuu tou te sopoia atu ai Ioritana e fai mo outou; tou te le nofo tulu‘i ai, a e matuā faaumatia outou.

verses.en: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
verses.sm: E faataapeape e Ieova ia te outou i nuu eseese, e toaitiiti foi ni o outou e totoe i nuu e ta‘ita‘iina ai outou e Ieova;

verses.en: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.sm: tou te auauna ai i atua na faia e lima o tagata, o laau ma maa, o e le vaai, ma latou le faalogologo, latou te le aai, ma latou le sogisogi,

verses.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.sm: A e afai tou te toe saili ia Ieova lou Atua i lea mea, ona e maua lea o ia, pe afai e te saili ia te ia ma lou loto atoa ma lou agaga atoa.

verses.en: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.sm: A oo ia te oe le puapuaga, a maua foi oe e ia mea uma lava i aso amuli, afai e te toe foi atu ia Ieova lou Atua, ma e faalogo i lona siufofoga,

verses.en: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.sm: (auā o Ieova lou Atua, o le Atua alofa ia,) na te le tuuna oe, na te le faaumatia oe, e le galo foi ia te ia le feagaiga ma ou tamā, na ia tauto ai ia te i latou.

verses.en: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
verses.sm: Auā ia e suesue i aso anamua na muamua ia te oe, talu le aso na faia ai tagata e le Atua i le lalolagi; ia iga o le lagi, e oo atu i le tasi tuluiga o le lagi, pe ai se mea e pei o lenei mea tele, pe na faalogoina e se tasi se mea la te tutusa?

verses.en: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.sm: Pe na faalogologo se nuu i le siufofoga o le Atua ua tulei mai i totonu o le afi, faapei ona e faalogologo i ai, a e ola mai pea ?

verses.en: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.sm: Pe na sauni ea e le Atua ona afio atu, ma ave mona le tasi nuu ai totonu o le tasi nuu, i tofotofoga, ma faailoga, ma vavega, ma le taua, ma le aao malosi, ma le aao faaloaloa, atoa ma mea matautia tele lava, faapei o mea uma na faia e Ieova lo outou Atua ia te outou i o outou luma i Aikupito ?

verses.en: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
verses.sm: Ua faailoaina atu ia te oe ina ia e iloa, o Ieova o ia lava le Atua, e leai se tasi na o ia lava.

verses.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.sm: Ua na tulei mai lona siufofoga mai le lagi ia lagona e oe, ina ia a‘oa‘o mai o ia ia te oe ; na ia faailoa mai foi ia te oe lana afi tele i le lalolagi, na e faalogologo foi i ana afioga ai totonu o le afi.

verses.en: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.sm: Na ia alofaina ou tamā, o le mea lea na ia filifilia ai a latou fanau, ina ua mavae atu i latou, ua na aumaia foi oe i ona luma i lona mana tele nai Aikupito;

verses.en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.sm: ina ia tulia nai ou luma o nuu e sili ona malolosi ma le toatele ia te oe, ina ia faaoo ia te oe, ma ia avatu lo latou laueleele e fai mou tofi, faapei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
verses.sm: la e iloa foi i le aso nei, ma ia mafaufau ai lou loto, o Ieova o ia lava le Atua i le lagi i luga, atoa ma le lalolagi nei, e leai lava se tasi.

verses.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia e tausiusi i ana tulafono ma ana poloaiga ou te fai atu ai ia te oe i le aso nei, ina ia manuia ai oe ma au fanau pe a mavae atu oe, ina ia e nofo tulu‘i ai i le laueleele ua foai mai ia te oe e Ieova lou Atua i aso uma lava.

verses.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.sm: Ona vavaeeseina lea e Mose o aai e tolu i le itu mai o Ioritana i le mea e alu ae ai le la;

verses.en: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.sm: ina ia sola i ai o le fasioti tagata, o le na te fasioti i le la te tuaoi ma le le iloa, e lei muai ita foi i ai; a sola foi o ia i se tasi o ia aai, ona ola ai lea o ia.

verses.en: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.sm: O aai ia, o Peseri i le vao i le eleele laugatasi, o sa Reupenā; ma Ramota i Kiliata, o sa Kat5; ma Koleni o i Vasana, o sa Manase.

verses.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.sm: O le tulafono lenei sa tuuina atu mau lava ia, ma tulafono,

verses.en: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
verses.sm: ma faamasinoga na fai atu ai Mose i le fanauga a Isaraelu ina ua latou o mai nai Aikupito,

verses.en: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.sm: i le itu mai o Ioritana i le vanu e feagai ma Petepeoro, i le laueleele o Sekono le tupu o sa Amori, sa nofo i Hesepona, o ia na fasia e Mose ma le fanauga a Isaraelu ina ua latou o mai mai Aikupito.

verses.en: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.sm: Ua latou fai mo latou lona laueleele, ma le laueleele o Oko le tupu o Vasana, o tupu e toalua o sa Amori i le itu mai o Ioritana i le mea e alu ae ai le la;

verses.en: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
verses.sm: e gata mai i Aroeru i le auvai o le alia o Arinona, e gata mai i le mauga o Seona, o Heremoni lea;

verses.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
verses.sm: ma le eleele laugatasi uma i le itu mai o Ioritana i sasae, e oo lava i le sami o i le eleele laugatasi i lalo o Asetotapeseka.
